timeout.recommendation: Database connection timeout is configured at the XORM engine level via app.ini [database] settings. Per-query timeouts are not set.

retry.recommendation: No retry logic for transient DB errors. Consider retry with backoff for connection errors.

circuit_breaker.recommendation: No circuit breaker on DB calls. XORM handles connection pooling but has no circuit breaker pattern.

bulkhead.recommendation: XORM connection pool provides basic isolation. Pool size configured via [database] MAX_OPEN_CONNS.

fallback.recommendation: No fallback for DB failures. Endpoints return 500 error. Consider returning cached/stale data for read endpoints.

idempotency.reason: Read operations (ep-019, ep-021, ep-022) are inherently idempotent. ep-020 writes are idempotent (setting status to same value is safe).

blast_radius.impact: All notification endpoints become unavailable. Users cannot view or manage notifications.

endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Always available as long as the process is running

findings.detail: No retry on transient DB errors for notification reads
findings.recommendation: Low priority - read endpoint, client can retry

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: DB down → 500 error → client sees no notifications

findings.detail: Updates notifications one-by-one in a loop without a transaction. If the loop fails midway, some notifications are marked read while others remain unread.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the update loop in a database transaction to ensure atomicity

findings.detail: Setting notification status is idempotent - retrying sets the same status again

non_atomic_operations: Loop of SetNotificationStatus calls without transaction wrapper - partial failure leaves inconsistent state
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: DB down → 500 error → notifications stuck in current state

findings.detail: No retry on transient DB errors for count query
findings.recommendation: Low priority - simple count query, client can retry

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: DB down → 422 error → client cannot check for new notifications

findings.detail: No retry on transient DB errors for notification reads
findings.recommendation: Low priority - read endpoint, client can retry

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: DB down → 500 error → client sees no repo notifications

health_checks.recommendation: Version endpoint serves as basic liveness. No dedicated readiness probe that checks DB connectivity.

graceful_shutdown.detail: Gitea uses graceful module (modules/graceful) for signal handling and request draining

rate_limiting.detail: No built-in API rate limiting. Relies on external reverse proxy.
rate_limiting.recommendation: Consider adding rate limiting for notification polling endpoints (ep-021 especially)

dead_letter_queues.detail: These endpoints are synchronous request-response. No async message processing.

single_points_of_failure: SQL database - all notification endpoints depend on it with no fallback
cascading_failure_paths: Database down → all notification endpoints (ep-019 to ep-022) return errors → UI notification badge broken
